tools.name: find_discussion_candidates
tools.description: Search Google and filter organic results (positions 1-100) specifically for community discussions and forum threads (Reddit, Quora, HackerNews, StackExchange, niche forums). Ideal for sentiment analysis, user discussions, and customer problem discovery.

tools.name: extract_local_places
tools.description: Extract Google Local Pack (3-pack) and Google Places listings for local queries. Returns place_id/cid, title, rating, review count, address, latitude/longitude, category, phone, and website.

tools.description: Extract Google Shopping carousel listings for e-commerce and product queries. Returns product title, price, currency, merchant, rating, reviews, image URL, link, and product ID.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_discussion_candidates, ai_answers · Private data: geo_citation_radar · Public sink: ai_answers · Destructive: google_serp, geo_citation_radar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_discussion_candidates, ai_answers · Private data: geo_citation_radar · Public sink: ai_answers · Destructive: google_serp, geo_citation_radar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
